When we got hit by an IED, basically all the dust in the vehicle levitated and you could feel the vibration through the haul. No damage done, no one injured.

So, we're In Mosul and the dismounts were out doing their thing. They're done. Drop ramp, let them in, raise ramp. I'm raising the ramp, and a muffled bumpf, all the settled dust is in the air around me. I can hear them screaming over the engine and my headset, "DROP RAMP! DROP RAMP!"

Holy shit... They just hit us with an IED when we're most vulnerable, when the ramp is down... Fuck me. I drop the ramp. My gunner and vehicle commander go off comms. I sitting there for 3-4 minutes talking into my headset, waiting for a response.

Finally, I climb out of the driver's hatch and walk around to the back of the vehicle. There's soldiers lying on the ground. Oh fuck, oh fuck....

They're on the ground laughing....

What the fuck...

I take off my headset. When they got in the vehicle, someone knocked the fire extinguisher out of place. It rolled onto the ramp, and when I was raising the ramp, that shit exploded, releasing a cloud of white shit through the whole vehicle.
